title: Viggāhikā
text: 2. Mā bhikkhave viggāhikakathaṃ katheyyātha || Na tvam imaṃ dhammavinayam ājānāsi || aham imaṃ dhammavinayam ājānāmi || kiṃ tvam imaṃ dhammavinayam ājānissasi || || Micchāpaṭipanno tvam asi || aham asmi sammāpaṭipanno || || Pure vacanīyam pacchā avaca pacchā vacanīyam pure avaca || || Sahitam me asahitan te || || Āciṇṇan te viparāvattaṃ || || Āropito te vādo || cara vādappamokkhāya Niggahīto si nibbeṭhehi sace pahosī ti || || Taṃ kissa hetu || || 3. Nesā bhikkhave kathā atthasaṃhitā nādibrahmacariyikā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati || || 4. Kathentā ca kho tumhe bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti katheyyātha || pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti katheyyātha || || Taṃ kissa hetu || || 5. Esā hi bhikkhave kathā || pa || yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
